name: DONDA 2 [V1]
notes: (08/29/2021) (Donda officially releases) (11/15/2021) (Donda (Deluxe) officially releases) (12/01/2022) (Ye appears on InfoWars with Alex Jones)
description: In Feburary 2022, Ye announced a sequel to Donda, exectutively produced by Future and intended to release 2.22.22. Following this, Ye and his collaborators began rushing to complete the project. Ye also found himself in many controversies, with him constantly harassing Kim Kardashian's boyfriend Pete Davidson on Instagram. A listening party for the project was held on 2.22.22, with the project being released on the Stem Player the next day, albeit unfinished. Ye got into even more controversies, namely proclaiming "White Lives Matter" at YZYSZN9 and saying he was going to go "death con 3" on the Jews, making him get dropped by Adidas and lose his billionaire status.
